name: Ashen Graveyard
identity: Physical and Bleed undead. The Ashen Warden telegraphs Grave Cleave and cages you in Bone Prison.
flavour: The first field. The soil is more ash than earth, and the markers have no names.

name: Ember Canyon
identity: Fire and armor-shredding cinder beasts. The Ember Colossus enters Molten Overdrive at 50% Life.
flavour: The canyon breathes heat. Somewhere below, something is still being forged.

name: Frozen Cathedral
identity: Frost and Void wards. The Glacial Archon regenerates Ward between Astral Shatter casts.
flavour: The hymns are still in the ice. The congregation is not.
